title: NexGo Ride Standard (v0.2.0 draft)
description: Successor draft to nexgo-ride.v0.1.0. Replaces the single passenger-asserted raw ride blob with a real on-chain handshake. This standard now defines ONLY the domain-specific request profile (nexgo-ride-request, which needs queryable geohash fields for p2p discovery); the driver-signed offer and the fare-locked agreement are the SHARED generic types from agreement.v0.2.0 (distordia-offer / distordia-agreement, domain='nexgo.ride'). Atomic invoice settlement is kept. See docs/nexgo-cluster-design-note.md and docs/agent-swarm-nexus-alignment-note.md.
maxSize: 1KB per asset (system fields ~180 bytes, ~820 bytes for data).

usesSharedTypes.offer: distordia-offer -- created on the DRIVER'S OWN sigchain (the consent handshake missing from v0.1.0). 'resource' holds the driver's nexgo-taxi self-addr; 'price-milli' is the quoted fare; 'eta-sec' the pickup ETA.
usesSharedTypes.agreement: distordia-agreement -- created by the passenger accepting one offer. 'price-milli' is the LOCKED fare and the Nexus invoice amount MUST equal it; 'contract' references that invoice; 'proof-hash' may anchor the off-chain p2p trip record.
usesSharedTypes.rationale: nexgo-ride-offer and nexgo-ride-agreement were structurally identical to swarm missions and to any other two-party commitment. Consolidating avoids maintaining the same handshake three times and lets ratings, reputation and settlement work uniformly across domains.

assetTypes.description: Domain request profile for ride-hailing. Kept domain-specific because pickup/destination geohash and seats must be QUERYABLE on-chain for p2p geo-sharded discovery. Precise coordinates are NOT on-chain -- only coarse geohash buckets; exact pickup is shared p2p after a match.

self-addr.description: Queryable copy of this asset's register address; referenced by distordia-offer as 'request'.

domain.description: Always 'nexgo.ride'. Aligns this profile with the shared agreement standard so generic offers and agreements can reference it.

passenger.description: Passenger NAMESPACE. Nexus namespace rules apply: lowercase letters, numbers and periods only (hyphens are INVALID on-chain).

pickup-geohash.description: Coarse pickup area (geohash, ~6 chars). Precise pickup shared p2p only after a match -- privacy by construction.

max-price-milli.description: Maximum fare the passenger will accept, in milli-units of 'currency'. Named to match the shared request contract.

expires-ts.description: Unix expiry; drivers ignore expired requests.

steps: 1. Passenger creates nexgo-ride-request (geohash buckets, max-price-milli, status=open).
2. Drivers discover it via a geo-scoped on-chain query and create a DRIVER-SIGNED distordia-offer (domain='nexgo.ride', resource=<taxi self-addr>, price-milli <= max-price-milli, eta-sec).
3. Passenger picks one offer and creates a distordia-agreement referencing request+offer; fare locked. Exact pickup is shared with that driver over the p2p channel.
4. Driver creates a Nexus invoice for price-milli; passenger pays atomically (DEBIT + CLAIM); agreement status=funded, then settled.
5. Trip occurs; live location over direct encrypted p2p (no coordinates on-chain). On completion status=settled, optionally with proof-hash of the trip record.
6. Passenger may submit a nexgo-rating referencing the distordia-agreement self-addr (verified-ride gating).

examples._comment: Open ride-request (coarse geohash buckets, no precise coordinates).
The driver's response is a SHARED distordia-offer (from agreement.v0.2.0), not a NexGo-specific type.

queryFilters.openRequestsNearby: distordia-type = 'nexgo-ride-request' AND status = 'open' AND pickup-geohash LIKE '{geohash}%'
queryFilters.ridesForDriver: distordia-type = 'distordia-agreement' AND domain = 'nexgo.ride' AND party-b = '{driver namespace}'

notes: Only the request profile is NexGo-specific; the offer and agreement are the shared generic types from agreement.v0.2.0 (domain='nexgo.ride').
Driver-signed offer fixes the v0.1.0 trust asymmetry (the passenger could not legitimately assert the driver's acceptance).
Fare is agreed BEFORE payment and bound to the invoice -- no post-acceptance surprise invoicing.
Coarse geohash buckets replace permanent on-chain coordinates; precise pickup is p2p after match.
Discovery is p2p on-chain via geohash-scoped queries; an optional permissionless indexer can cache shards.
Successor draft to nexgo-ride.v0.1.0 (standards/nexgo-ride-standard.json), retained for history.
